name: Sigmoid Function with Jacobian
definition: Computes the sigmoid function $\sigma(x) = \frac{1}{1+e^{-x}}$ and its derivative $\sigma'(x) = \sigma(x)(1-\sigma(x))$.
summary: Computes the logistic sigmoid and its derivative, mapping inputs to a bounded range with an asymmetric S-shape, distinguishing it from symmetric Gaussian transfer functions.
